mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4, reducing atorvastatin metabolism and significantly increasing statin plasma concentrations, elevating myopathy and rhabdomyolysis risk.
action: Consider alternative antibiotic (e.g., azithromycin, doxycycline) or temporarily discontinue atorvastatin; if continuation necessary, reduce atorvastatin dose and monitor for muscle symptoms.
